svg.aria-label: Left: three PyTorch optimisers on a stretched quadratic bowl. Plain SGD must use a small step because of the steep direction and crawls along the gentle one; momentum builds speed along the valley; Adam rescales each coordinate and moves diagonally. Right: loss per step on a log scale
